## Acquisition flow
Search or social discovery -> useful service/solution page -> free technical tool or project brief -> lead capture -> qualification -> human follow-up.

## Security boundary
All cybersecurity testing requires appropriate client authorization and defined scope. Public passive scanning does not authorize intrusive testing.
